## Updraft 0.7.9

A big one: 21 changes, all checked overnight so dictation stays just as fast. New features are off until you turn them on.

### New
- **New: Documents.** A Documents page for your PDFs and scans. Updraft reads the text in scanned pages so you can search them, and you can rotate, delete and reorder pages. Optional extras, each with its own switch: sort rules (with Claude suggestions if no rule fits), key fields like dates and amounts, fill and sign, separator sheets to split a stack of scans, and phone access over Tailscale with a "file is ready" notice and Send to phone. Off until you turn it on in Settings › Documents.
- **New: screen recording extras.** Click highlights, a cursor spotlight, drawing on the screen while you record (hold Ctrl+Shift), blur boxes to hide part of the screen (Ctrl+Alt+B), and a blurred background behind your webcam. Each is off until you turn it on.
- **New: recording transcripts.** After a screen recording is saved, Updraft can write a transcript, a short Claude summary with chapters, and make it searchable. It waits while you dictate. Off until you turn it on.
- **New: Calendar names for recordings.** Recordings can take their name and attendee names from your Google or Outlook calendar. Read-only. Off until you turn it on, and it needs a one-time setup.
- **New: mail search and Google Drive save for Claude.** Claude can search your Gmail or Outlook (read-only, it never sends mail) and save files to Google Drive. Off until you turn it on, and it needs a one-time setup.
- **New: Send to Drift.** On the Clipboard page, text and links get a Send to Drift button, and Drift picks them up as reading highlights. Off until you turn it on.
- **New: Whisper Mode.** A setting for dictating quietly: Updraft boosts quiet speech so it hears you. The Voice Test has a new whispered set to check it. Off until you turn it on in Settings › Speaking.

### Improved
- **Improved: updates install themselves.** "Update automatically" is now on unless you switched it off before. Updraft checks about a minute after it starts and then weekly, downloads quietly (never while you dictate or record), and only takes versions at least a day old. On Windows it installs when Updraft quits; on the Mac it stops at "Update ready" as before.
- **Improved: one look across your apps.** The main window, Settings, pop-ups, the meeting bar and the screen recording windows now share the same colors, buttons and switches as your other apps.
- **Improved: lighter app.** Leftover code was cleaned out.

### Fixed
- **Fixed: meeting search no longer shows the same snippet twice** when two search words sit close together.
- **Fixed: recording thumbnails** now show when the recordings folder is reached through a shortcut path.
